p1: My dog Max sleeps under my bed every single night.
Unless there's a storm. Then he hides in the laundry, and nothing gets him out.
Every night, I hang my hand over the edge, and he licks it.
That's how I know I'm not alone.
Last night, a storm knocked the power out.
I couldn't sleep, so I let my hand hang down.
Something warm licked my fingers. Slowly.
At three in the morning, my phone buzzed. It was my neighbour.
Found your dog in my yard. He's soaked. I'll bring him back in the morning.
Under the bed, something licked my hand again.
And a voice whispered... Good. Boy.
Follow. And keep your hands on the bed tonight.
